method: May-effects grouped by inspected workspace-owned boundary. External subprocesses, network peers and arbitrary CheckRunner/transport implementations stop the guarantee; they are not labeled pure. A matching hash detects drift, not truth of the annotation.

resolve.condition: Explicit --log and HUGIT_LOG are prepared when recognized as canonical runtime paths; default resolution can migrate if canonical or legacy state exists. Unrelated file logs do not inherit every migration effect.
resolve.call_path: log_resolve::resolve_log_for_repo -> runtime_store::prepare_runtime_log / migrate; for_repo -> git rev-parse

read_log.condition: When an explicit or resolved log is loaded; no migration is performed by load_event_log itself.

write_log.condition: When a mutation persists. Lock preparation can run migration; refusal may already have created coordination state. Authorization denial can itself be an event.
write_log.call_path: FileLock::acquire -> prepare_runtime_log -> acquire_unprepared; persist -> atomic_write -> prepare_runtime_write -> atomic_write_unprepared

projection.condition: fleet/watch load materialized projection status, even though their final operation is a query.

check.condition: A cache MISS executes the resolved built-in/ad-hoc shell command in a mutable worktree. Cache writes do not require --store. --store additionally records an event; configured tools and descendants are not a sandbox.
check.call_path: checks::run::run -> captured_hermetic_env / ancestor_config_digest / resolve_def -> snapshot_tree -> run_memoized -> ProcessRunner / FileAc; --store -> record_on_log

intent_store.condition: New intent creation resolves the default log for seal checks even with an explicit store. Canonical persistence and store persistence are ordered separate writes; replay is not a joint transaction.
intent_store.call_path: intent::new::run -> resolve_log(None) -> IntentStore::lock/load; optional canonical_log::land_intent -> save_locked

intent_query.condition: Store entries can reference a source log; inspect explicit log / recorded source / default-log fallback. Store absence is not successful empty provenance.
intent_query.call_path: intent::list::run / show::run -> store + origin lookup; default-log fallback can use resolve_log

attach.condition: --preview returns before installation. --adopt-managed-dispatcher authorizes the observed foreign hook. --detach uses hooks-v1 ownership, not the top-level detach handler.
attach.call_path: attach::run -> do_run -> hooks_dir/common_dir -> read_regular_or_absent; installation writes foreign backup, dispatcher and manifest; detach validates ownership

detach.condition: Only the init adoption format and recognized hooks are handled. Do not assume compatibility with attach hooks-v1.
detach.call_path: init::detach_run -> read_adoption_manifest -> restore matching backup -> remove is_managed_hook entries

setup.condition: --status reads only its setup branch. --repo installs repository hooks; default setup writes a template and global init.templateDir. Existing global value replacement requires its explicit flag.
setup.call_path: setup::run -> do_status | do_setup -> init::install_hooks | git config --global init.templateDir

health.condition: Inspects hook/runtime state and Git hook capability. A process exit of zero is not proof that every hook is active.

capture.condition: Six capture kinds feed immutable receipts. --drain-worker instead consumes receipts. Public capture converts recording failures to silent exit zero; this is not a durability ACK. Safe receipt claims have explicit non-Unix refusal paths.
capture.call_path: capture::run -> resolve_log_for_repo -> capture_* -> capture_ref_update -> receipt publication -> drain::start_detached; --drain-worker -> drain::drain

drain.condition: Detached worker sorts a bounded receipt batch, commits canonical evidence, marks completion/dead-letter and persists status. Missing acknowledgement is not proof of no write.
drain.call_path: drain::drain -> acquire_drain_lock -> claim_receipt -> drain_one -> mark_completed/dead_letter -> reconcile_pairing_projection -> cleanup_completed -> write_current_status

git_read.condition: Git subprocesses inspect supplied repositories/OIDs. The executable/configuration is part of the trust boundary; no whole-process no-network claim is inferred.

input_file.condition: Input is read from the supplied file/graph/context. Parsing it is not execution of the application described in it.
input_file.call_path: run_impact -> input graph; symbol::project -> source bytes; policy::test -> evaluation context

export.condition: CLI constructs Corpus from EventLog plus default fields, not all files in the repository. Export creates Git/envelope artifacts under the requested output directory.

queue_sim.condition: Local union adapters consume IDs and declared conflict pairs. A green simulated adapter is not execution over an integrated Git tree.
queue_sim.call_path: land::run_queue_land -> local inputs + LocalRunner + union evaluator -> persist result

dock.condition: Resolution may coin a missing dock and write a marker. close/reconcile settle accounting and ghosts; listing an explicit dock is not automatic closure.
dock.call_path: dock::resolve::resolve -> coin_dock; close::close_dock/reconcile -> guarded append; query paths only inspect known records/gitdir

dock_sim.condition: --id bypasses implicit resolver; absent ID can coin. Git tip identity and synthetic acceptance are different checks. --no-accept prevents green. Successful settlement subsequently invokes close accounting.
dock_sim.call_path: dock::land::run -> resolve if needed -> land_dock -> observe_worktree_tip + run_dock_acceptance(DockRunner) -> atomic_write -> close_dock

dispatch_residue.condition: Only pr land --dispatch reaches the configured runner transport; incompatible manual metrics are refused first. This discontinued optional route is inventoried, not enabled or endorsed.
dispatch_residue.call_path: pr::cli::run_land -> LeaseClient::from_runtime -> land_with_dispatch -> dispatch_pr_metrics/dispatch_attest_offbox -> settle; no proof of real acceptance inferred from metrics

mcp_child.condition: Per-call hugit_bin > HUGIT_BIN > PATH selects the child. Args, current directory and log resolution change its behavior. Child effects are unconstrained unless the intended executable is qualified; stdio framing is not a sandbox.
mcp_child.call_path: tools::capture/land_status -> resolve_log -> Command::new(configured binary).output; capture returns dispatched, not receipt ACK

mcp_http.condition: cost-attest uses engine_base/repo/token; liveness-probe calls readyz plus optional light probe. Invalid/forbidden input can refuse before HTTP. Transport has timeouts, but this map does not certify total output bounds or credential handling.

value.condition: Pure value manipulation within the named function; all commands still parse input and emit output. Does not imply semantic correctness of user-supplied axes/path approximations.
value.call_path: check::key -> compute_memo_key; claim_disjointness -> AffectedSet; tournament produces descriptors, not agent executions

global_conditions: CLI parse/help and MCP JSON-RPC framing are input/output boundaries, not application verification.
A returned error can follow durable writes; no rollback or absence-of-effects follows from exit code alone.
HUGIT_LOG/explicit log and Git common-dir resolution affect multiple commands. Direct load_event_log is only file loading, not implicit migration.
PATH-selected Git/rustc and configured HUGIT_BIN are external executable trust boundaries. No network-isolation claim is made.
On non-Unix, safe receipt claiming/removal explicitly refuses. Compilation on a platform is not functioning capture qualification.
Builtin check command wins over --cmd; --store governs the event, not caching; env/toolchain/snapshot identities do not impose sandboxing.
The goal hook is an existing-user requirement to be qualified by HUG-057. intent new and branch-derived dock charter are not substituted as proof.
Network residues are classified for removal by HUG-004. They are not reintroduced as standalone dependencies.
review_requirements: Validate each call path and its conditions against the pinned source, not only this checker.
Do not promote direct handler, fixture, synthetic runner or subprocess fake tests to broader integration evidence.
Compare this inventory with public library/binary/automation surfaces before accepting HUG-001-SC01.
A reviewer distinct from the author must evaluate criterion-level evidence; this document does not create that approval.

generator_boundary.condition: Explicit developer invocation; uses compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and writes schemas and tests/golden. Not launched by ordinary Hugit capture.

library_interpretation: Cargo resolution/classification, not proof that every API is called, pure, or live. Default/all-features graphs remain in the required mechanical basis. test-support/test-internals features remain explicitly visible; external dependency sources are not read here.
acceptance_limit: This inventory accounts for named runtime entrypoints and workspace targets; automation/scripts and all reachable condition combinations still require criterion review. No whole-WP acceptance, product qualification or independent approval is emitted.
